task.ques: Browse ESPN to find out when the next game of the Los Angeles Lakers will start. Then navigate to the ticket purchasing website from ESPN, what is the cheapest ticket available.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The Lakers’ next game is away against the LA Clippers at Intuit Dome on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 10:30 p.m. Eastern / 7:30 p.m. Pacific. The cheapest available listing on Vivid Seats is US$67 per ticket including fees, in Terrace T2, Row 11, listed for two tickets. A single-ticket search starts at US$77.

ESPN identifies the next game and links to Vivid Seats: https://www.espn.com/nba/game/_/gameId/401909892/lakers-clippers . On the event page, “Any Quantity” and “Lowest Price” show the $67 listing first: https://www.vividseats.com/la-clippers-tickets-intuit-dome-10-28-2026/production/7433102 . The schedule advertises “From $66,” but the available event inventory and event minimum support $67 including fees. final.png shows the event, start time, quantity filter, lowest-price sort, section, row and fee-inclusive price.
